In addition to releasing the second public beta of macOS 27.2 Golden Gate, Apple is now rolling out the first release candidates (RC) of macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2. Details below.

Older versions of macOS continue to receive security updates

Following the usual practice for minor updates to older macOS versions, Apple today released the first release candidates of macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2, without first putting out standard beta versions.

Apple released macOS Sequoia 15.8.1 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.1 at the end of last month, with both versions going through two release candidates before their official rollout.

Apple's release notes for the first release candidates of macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 only mention that they "provide important security fixes and are recommended for all users." Last month's update included a security fix for CoreGraphics, which read as follows:

Apple is expected to publish details of the fixes after macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 and macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 are officially released, with the final versions likely to launch over the coming weeks alongside macOS 27.2 Golden Gate.

macOS Sequoia 15.8.2 RC 1 carries build number 24H219, while macOS Tahoe 26.7.2 RC 1 carries build number 25G320.

Have you spotted anything new or different in today's release candidates? Let us know in the comments.
